Separately, the restaurant's own site (pacificpizza.net/menu, now on Popmenu, generated fresh today 2026-08-30) exposes real first-party JSON-LD with its own prices for the same size-based "Build Your Own Hand-Tossed Pizza" section: 14" Medium $14.00, 16" Large $16.00, 18" XLarge $18.00, GF 10" $16.00, GF 14" $18.00, plus Slice $4.00 and 2 Slices & Drink combo $7.00. These do not reconcile with EITHER the raw Slice price ($22.80) OR the markup-implied real price ($19.00) -- Slice/own-site ratio is 1.63x, not a clean fee -- so per PLAYBOOK rule 6 ("disagreement is information... blocked, not a partial") this is being blocked rather than filed with either number. Needs a browser to resolve the size-pricing conflict and pull the full Popmenu catalog.
